name: National Security Policy of Pakistan (2022–2026)
owner: Ministry of Information Technology and Telecommunication (MoITT) & National Security Division of Pakistan
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Ministry of Information Technology and Telecommunication (MoITT) & National Security Division of Pakistan (moitt.gov.pk) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Ministry of Information Technology and Telecommunication (MoITT) & National Security Division of Pakistan (moitt.gov.pk).
